  - **Logic**: A dimension node is one of three variants. `CssPercentage` is always valid. `CssUnknownDimension` (unit not a known CSS keyword — the parser only produces this for unrecognized units) is always flagged. `CssRegularDimension` (a known unit) is valid *except* for `x`, which is a resolution unit and is only allowed inside a resolution context (`image-set()`/`-webkit-image-set()`, the `resolution` media feature, or the `image-resolution` property). Units are compared case-insensitively.
